question:
Parts of the following sentences have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Paul and I played tennis yesterday. He’s better than me, so he win easily.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**win**" in the phrase "**so he win easily**."
 
• The correct form should be "**won**" to match the present simple tense for third-person singular subjects.
 
• The revised phrase should be "**so he won easily**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Paul and I played tennis yesterday. He’s much better than me, so he **won** easily.*
